const t222EvidenceRoot = "/Users/marat/.codex/visualizations/2026/10/03/01a102d8-ab74-7d20-b2e5-79ecea218b46/remediation-20261004-01/EVIDENCE/T22"

// Root dispatches seed and replay as different Go test processes. Production
// Planner and JobRepository own all lifecycle writes. Collaborators are named
// bounded fixtures; this proves neither real LLM/validator/Practice services nor
// public publication. No job state is seeded by SQL; all rows remain retained.
func TestT222ActualStagedReplay(t *testing.T) {
	if os.Getenv("T222_TZ_PROOF") != "1" {
		t.Skip("root-dispatched actual TZ PostgreSQL seed/replay proof")
	}
	phase := os.Getenv("T222_TZ_PHASE")
	if phase != "seed" && phase != "replay" {
		t.Fatal("SETUP: T222_TZ_PHASE must be seed or replay")
	}
	seedFile := t222EvidenceFile(t, os.Getenv("T222_TZ_SEED_FILE"))
	dsn := os.Getenv("T222_TZ_DATABASE_URL")
	cfg, err := pgxpool.ParseConfig(dsn)
	if err != nil || cfg.ConnConfig.Host != "127.0.0.1" || cfg.ConnConfig.Port != 58998 || cfg.ConnConfig.Database != "remediation_t222_tz_integration_proof" || cfg.ConnConfig.User != "postgres" || cfg.ConnConfig.Password != "" || cfg.ConnConfig.TLSConfig != nil {
		t.Fatal("SETUP: exact isolated TZ T22.2 PostgreSQL database required")
	}
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 90*time.Second)
	defer cancel()
	if phase == "seed" {
		if _, e := os.Stat(seedFile); e == nil || !os.IsNotExist(e) {
			t.Fatal("SETUP: seed metadata must use a fresh owned path")
		}
		// Existing production migration loader/ledger, root-authorized only in
		// seed and only for this newly provisioned DB; replay performs no DDL.
		conn, e := pgx.ConnectConfig(ctx, cfg.ConnConfig.Copy())
		if e != nil {
			t.Fatalf("SETUP: migration connection: %T", e)
		}
		migrations, e := postgres.LoadMigrations("../../db/migrations")
		if e != nil || len(migrations) != 3 {
			_ = conn.Close(ctx)
			t.Fatal("SETUP: expected exactly existing forward migrations 001–003")
		}
		if e = postgres.ApplyMigrations(ctx, conn, migrations); e != nil {
			_ = conn.Close(ctx)
			t.Fatalf("SETUP: production migration ledger: %T", e)
		}
		applied, e := postgres.AppliedMigrations(ctx, conn)
		if e != nil || len(applied) != 3 {
			_ = conn.Close(ctx)
			t.Fatal("SETUP: migration ledger count mismatch")
		}
		for i, item := range applied {
			if item.Filename != migrations[i].Filename || item.SHA256 != migrations[i].SHA256 {
				_ = conn.Close(ctx)
				t.Fatal("SETUP: recorded migration checksum mismatch")
			}
		}
		if e = conn.Close(ctx); e != nil {
			t.Fatal("migration connection close failed")
		}
	}
	pool, err := pgxpool.NewWithConfig(ctx, cfg)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("SETUP: actual pool: %T", err)
	}
	defer pool.Close()
	if err = pool.Ping(ctx); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("SETUP: actual DB unavailable: %T", err)
	}
	repository := postgres.JobRepository{Pool: pool}
	var metadata t222SeedMetadata
	if phase == "seed" {
		metadata = t222Seed(t, ctx, pool, repository, seedFile)
	} else {
		metadata = t222LoadSeed(t, seedFile)
		t222Replay(t, ctx, pool, repository, metadata)
	}
	if resultFile := os.Getenv("T222_TZ_RESULT_FILE"); resultFile != "" && !t.Failed() {
		resultFile = t222EvidenceFile(t, resultFile)
		result := map[string]any{"status": "PASS", "phase": phase, "process_id": os.Getpid(), "seed_process_id": metadata.SeedPID, "jobs": metadata.Jobs, "ledger_sha256": metadata.LedgerHash, "retained_rows": true, "proof": "production Planner/PostgreSQL lifecycle with named collaborator fixtures", "actual_model_validator_practice_services": false, "public_release": false}
		raw, e := json.MarshalIndent(result, "", "  ")
		if e != nil {
			t.Fatal(e)
		}
		if e = os.WriteFile(resultFile, append(raw, '\n'), 0600); e != nil {
			t.Fatal("safe phase result write failed")
		}
	}
}

type t222SeedJob struct {
	Name          string `json:"name"`
	ID            string `json:"job_id"`
	Key           string `json:"idempotency_key"`
	RequestSchema string `json:"request_schema"`
	RequestHash   string `json:"request_hash"`
	Attempts      int    `json:"attempts"`
	RowHash       string `json:"row_sha256"`
}
type t222SeedMetadata struct {
	Schema     string        `json:"schema"`
	SeedPID    int           `json:"seed_process_id"`
	LedgerHash string        `json:"ledger_sha256"`
	Jobs       []t222SeedJob `json:"jobs"`
}

func t222Seed(t *testing.T, ctx context.Context, pool *pgxpool.Pool, repository postgres.JobRepository, seedFile string) t222SeedMetadata {
	t.Helper()
	task := validPreparedSourceTask()
	source := domain.PlanningRequestV1{Schema: domain.PlanningRequestSchemaV3, Mode: "private", Locale: "en", Source: domain.PlanningSource{Type: "github_repository", URL: task.Source.RepositoryURL, Company: "Acme"}, Hints: domain.ClassificationHint{Stacks: []string{"javascript"}}, PreparedSourceTask: &task}
	cases := []struct {
		name     string
		request  domain.PlanningRequestV1
		attempts int
	}{
		{"v1_staged_normal", validRequest("T22.2 named bounded intent fixture"), 1},
		{"v2_staged_attempt5", validV2Request("T22.2 named bounded project fixture", domain.SurfaceClassificationProject, "beginner"), 5},
		{"v3_source_staged_normal", source, 1},
	}
	metadata := t222SeedMetadata{Schema: "t222-staged-seed.v1", SeedPID: os.Getpid(), LedgerHash: t222LedgerHash(t, ctx, pool)}
	for _, item := range cases {
		t.Run(item.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			key := newUUID()
			if item.attempts == 5 {
				normalized, hash, e := normalizePlanningRequest(item.request)
				if e != nil {
					t.Fatal("SETUP: valid bounded request rejected")
				}
				now := time.Now().UTC()
				job, created, e := repository.Ensure(ctx, domain.PlanningJob{ID: newUUID(), IdempotencyKey: key, RequestHash: hash, Request: normalized, Status: domain.JobStatusPlanned, CreatedAt: now, UpdatedAt: now})
				if e != nil || !created {
					t.Fatalf("SETUP: initial lifecycle Ensure: created=%v err=%T", created, e)
				}
				for i := 1; i <= 4; i++ {
					token := newUUID()
					claimed, e := repository.Claim(ctx, job.ID, token, time.Now().UTC(), time.Minute)
					if e != nil || claimed.Attempts != i || claimed.Status != domain.JobStatusGenerating {
						t.Fatalf("real failure attempt %d Claim failed: %T", i, e)
					}
					if e = repository.SaveFailed(ctx, job.ID, token, "t222_named_preterminal_failure", time.Now().UTC()); e != nil {
						t.Fatalf("real failure attempt %d SaveFailed: %T", i, e)
					}
					failed, e := repository.Get(ctx, job.ID)
					if e != nil || failed.Status != domain.JobStatusFailed || failed.Attempts != i || failed.LeaseToken != "" || failed.Artifact != nil {
						t.Fatal("real failed lifecycle state did not persist")
					}
				}
			}
			fixtures := &t222NamedPorts{}
			planner := t222Planner(repository, fixtures)
			job, created, e := planner.Plan(ctx, key, item.request)
			if e != nil || job.Status != domain.JobStatusReady || job.Artifact == nil || !job.Artifact.Verification.Passed || job.Attempts != item.attempts || (item.attempts == 1 && !created) || (item.attempts == 5 && created) {
				t.Fatalf("actual production Plan did not persist READY: status=%s attempts=%d created=%v err=%T", job.Status, job.Attempts, created, e)
			}
			staged, e := planner.Stage(ctx, job.ID)
			if e != nil || staged.Status != domain.JobStatusStaged || staged.Staging == nil || staged.Staging.AuthoringJobID != job.ID || staged.LeaseToken != "" || staged.LeaseExpiresAt != nil || staged.LegacyPublicationPresent {
				t.Fatalf("actual production Stage did not persist private receipt: status=%s err=%T", staged.Status, e)
			}
			if fixtures.calls[t222Generate].Load() != 1 || fixtures.calls[t222Stage].Load() != 1 || fixtures.calls[t222Inspect].Load() != 1 || fixtures.calls[t222Verify].Load() != 1 || fixtures.calls[t222WorkspaceCreate].Load() == 0 || fixtures.calls[t222WorkspaceCreate].Load() != fixtures.calls[t222WorkspaceDelete].Load() {
				t.Fatal("named collaborator pipeline counters did not establish real persisted authoring/staging flow")
			}
			rowHash := t222RowHash(t, ctx, pool, job.ID)
			metadata.Jobs = append(metadata.Jobs, t222SeedJob{Name: item.name, ID: job.ID, Key: key, RequestSchema: staged.Request.Schema, RequestHash: staged.RequestHash, Attempts: staged.Attempts, RowHash: rowHash})
			t.Logf("persisted named staged fixture: job=%s schema=%s attempts=%d row_sha256=%s", job.ID, staged.Request.Schema, staged.Attempts, rowHash)
		})
	}
	t.Run("real_nonterminal_lease_failure_and_cap_control", func(t *testing.T) { t222NonterminalControl(t, ctx, pool, repository) })
	if t.Failed() || len(metadata.Jobs) != 3 {
		t.Fatal("seed fixtures incomplete; no replay metadata published")
	}
	raw, e := json.MarshalIndent(metadata, "", "  ")
	if e != nil {
		t.Fatal(e)
	}
	file, e := os.OpenFile(seedFile, os.O_CREATE|os.O_EXCL|os.O_WRONLY, 0600)
	if e != nil {
		t.Fatal("fresh seed metadata creation failed")
	}
	if _, e = file.Write(append(raw, '\n')); e != nil {
		_ = file.Close()
		t.Fatal("safe seed metadata write failed")
	}
	if e = file.Close(); e != nil {
		t.Fatal("seed metadata close failed")
	}
	return metadata
}

func t222Replay(t *testing.T, ctx context.Context, pool *pgxpool.Pool, repository postgres.JobRepository, metadata t222SeedMetadata) {
	t.Helper()
	if metadata.SeedPID == os.Getpid() {
		t.Fatal("SETUP: replay must run in a separate Go test process")
	}
	ledgerBefore := t222LedgerHash(t, ctx, pool)
	if ledgerBefore != metadata.LedgerHash {
		t.Fatal("SETUP: retained migration ledger changed between seed/replay")
	}
	for _, seed := range metadata.Jobs {
		t.Run(seed.Name, func(t *testing.T) {
			stored, e := repository.Get(ctx, seed.ID)
			if e != nil || stored.ID != seed.ID || stored.IdempotencyKey != seed.Key || stored.RequestHash != seed.RequestHash || stored.Request.Schema != seed.RequestSchema || stored.Attempts != seed.Attempts || stored.Status != domain.JobStatusStaged || stored.Artifact == nil || stored.Staging == nil {
				t.Fatalf("SETUP: retained staged job mismatch: status=%s err=%T", stored.Status, e)
			}
			before := t222RowHash(t, ctx, pool, stored.ID)
			if before != seed.RowHash {
				t.Fatal("SETUP: exact whole seeded row/xmin changed before replay")
			}
			ports := &t222NamedPorts{trap: true}
			planner := t222Planner(repository, ports)
			planned, created, e := planner.Plan(ctx, stored.IdempotencyKey, stored.Request)
			t222AssertReplay(t, "Plan", planned, created, e, stored)
			processed, e := planner.Process(ctx, stored.ID)
			t222AssertReplay(t, "Process", processed, false, e, stored)
			staged, e := planner.Stage(ctx, stored.ID)
			t222AssertReplay(t, "Stage", staged, false, e, stored)
			claimed, e := repository.Claim(ctx, stored.ID, newUUID(), time.Now().UTC(), time.Minute)
			t222AssertReplay(t, "repository Claim terminal fallback", claimed, false, e, stored)
			// Every collaborator trap is atomic and immutable; duplicate Plan,
			// Process and existing Stage calls are safe to run concurrently.
			type outcome struct {
				kind    string
				job     domain.PlanningJob
				created bool
				err     error
			}
			outcomes := make(chan outcome, 12)
			start := make(chan struct{})
			var wait sync.WaitGroup
			for i := 0; i < 12; i++ {
				wait.Add(1)
				go func(kind int) {
					defer wait.Done()
					<-start
					switch kind % 3 {
					case 0:
						j, c, e := planner.Plan(ctx, stored.IdempotencyKey, stored.Request)
						outcomes <- outcome{"concurrent Plan", j, c, e}
					case 1:
						j, e := planner.Process(ctx, stored.ID)
						outcomes <- outcome{"concurrent Process", j, false, e}
					case 2:
						j, e := planner.Stage(ctx, stored.ID)
						outcomes <- outcome{"concurrent Stage", j, false, e}
					}
				}(i)
			}
			close(start)
			wait.Wait()
			close(outcomes)
			for value := range outcomes {
				t222AssertReplay(t, value.kind, value.job, value.created, value.err, stored)
			}
			changed := stored.Request
			if changed.Locale == "en" {
				changed.Locale = "ru"
			} else {
				changed.Locale = "en"
			}
			_, _, e = planner.Plan(ctx, stored.IdempotencyKey, changed)
			if !errors.Is(e, domain.ErrConflict) {
				t.Errorf("changed normalized request must conflict: error=%T", e)
			}
			for i := range ports.calls {
				if ports.calls[i].Load() != 0 {
					t.Errorf("terminal replay invoked named collaborator %d: count=%d", i, ports.calls[i].Load())
				}
			}
			fresh, e := repository.Get(ctx, stored.ID)
			if e != nil || !reflect.DeepEqual(fresh, stored) || before != t222RowHash(t, ctx, pool, stored.ID) {
				t.Error("terminal replay changed artifact/receipt/attempts/time/lease or whole row/xmin")
			}
			var count int
			if e = pool.QueryRow(ctx, `SELECT count(*) FROM tz_authoring_job WHERE idempotency_key=$1`, stored.IdempotencyKey).Scan(&count); e != nil || count != 1 {
				t.Fatal("terminal replay duplicated exact idempotency job")
			}
			t.Logf("retained replay observation: job=%s attempts=%d row_sha256=%s collaborator_calls=%d", stored.ID, stored.Attempts, before, ports.total())
		})
	}
	if ledgerBefore != t222LedgerHash(t, ctx, pool) {
		t.Error("replay changed migration ledger")
	}
}

func t222AssertReplay(t *testing.T, operation string, job domain.PlanningJob, created bool, err error, want domain.PlanningJob) {
	t.Helper()
	if err != nil || created || !reflect.DeepEqual(job, want) {
		t.Errorf("%s terminal replay: job=%s status=%s attempts=%d created=%v error=%T want_unchanged_STAGED_attempts=%d", operation, job.ID, job.Status, job.Attempts, created, err, want.Attempts)
	}
}
func t222NonterminalControl(t *testing.T, ctx context.Context, pool *pgxpool.Pool, repository postgres.JobRepository) {
	t.Helper()
	request, hash, e := normalizePlanningRequest(validRequest("T22.2 named lease/cap lifecycle control"))
	if e != nil {
		t.Fatal(e)
	}
	now := time.Now().UTC()
	job, created, e := repository.Ensure(ctx, domain.PlanningJob{ID: newUUID(), IdempotencyKey: newUUID(), Request: request, RequestHash: hash, Status: domain.JobStatusPlanned, CreatedAt: now, UpdatedAt: now})
	if e != nil || !created {
		t.Fatal("nonterminal control Ensure failed")
	}
	for attempt := 1; attempt <= 5; attempt++ {
		token := newUUID()
		claimed, e := repository.Claim(ctx, job.ID, token, time.Now().UTC(), time.Minute)
		if e != nil || claimed.Attempts != attempt || claimed.Status != domain.JobStatusGenerating {
			t.Fatal("nonterminal control Claim failed")
		}
		before := t222RowHash(t, ctx, pool, job.ID)
		_, e = repository.Claim(ctx, job.ID, newUUID(), time.Now().UTC(), time.Minute)
		expected := domain.ErrLeaseHeld
		if attempt == 5 {
			expected = domain.ErrConflict
		}
		if !errors.Is(e, expected) || before != t222RowHash(t, ctx, pool, job.ID) {
			t.Fatal("active nonterminal lease/cap rejection changed retained row")
		}
		if e = repository.SaveFailed(ctx, job.ID, newUUID(), "t222_wrong_fence", time.Now().UTC()); !errors.Is(e, domain.ErrConflict) || before != t222RowHash(t, ctx, pool, job.ID) {
			t.Fatal("wrong nonterminal fence mutated retained row")
		}
		if e = repository.SaveFailed(ctx, job.ID, token, "t222_named_failure", time.Now().UTC()); e != nil {
			t.Fatal("nonterminal failure retry persistence failed")
		}
	}
	before := t222RowHash(t, ctx, pool, job.ID)
	if _, e = repository.Claim(ctx, job.ID, newUUID(), time.Now().UTC(), time.Minute); !errors.Is(e, domain.ErrConflict) || before != t222RowHash(t, ctx, pool, job.ID) {
		t.Fatal("failed nonterminal attempts5 cap changed")
	}
}

const (
	t222Generate = iota
	t222Discover
	t222Resolve
	t222Profiles
	t222Inspect
	t222Verify
	t222WorkspaceCreate
	t222WorkspaceDelete
	t222Stage
	t222PortCount
)

// Named fixture ports use atomic counters in both phases. Replay returns a
// sentinel before any private output is created; all counters must stay zero.
type t222NamedPorts struct {
	trap  bool
	calls [t222PortCount]atomic.Int64
}

func (p *t222NamedPorts) called(kind int) error {
	p.calls[kind].Add(1)
	if p.trap {
		return errors.New("named downstream collaborator unavailable during terminal replay")
	}
	return nil
}
func (p *t222NamedPorts) total() int64 {
	var result int64
	for i := range p.calls {
		result += p.calls[i].Load()
	}
	return result
}
func (p *t222NamedPorts) Generate(context.Context, domain.GenerationInput) (domain.AuthoringCandidateV1, error) {
	if e := p.called(t222Generate); e != nil {
		return domain.AuthoringCandidateV1{}, e
	}
	return validCandidate(), nil
}
func (p *t222NamedPorts) DiscoverTargets(ctx context.Context, stacks []string) ([]domain.LearningTargetDescriptor, error) {
	if e := p.called(t222Discover); e != nil {
		return nil, e
	}
	return (&competencyStub{}).DiscoverTargets(ctx, stacks)
}
func (p *t222NamedPorts) ResolveExactTargets(context.Context, []domain.LearningTargetRef) error {
	return p.called(t222Resolve)
}
func (p *t222NamedPorts) ListRuntimeProfiles(ctx context.Context) ([]domain.RuntimeProfileDescriptor, error) {
	if e := p.called(t222Profiles); e != nil {
		return nil, e
	}
	return (profileStub{}).ListRuntimeProfiles(ctx)
}
func (p *t222NamedPorts) InspectContract(ctx context.Context, raw json.RawMessage) (domain.ContractInspection, error) {
	if e := p.called(t222Inspect); e != nil {
		return domain.ContractInspection{}, e
	}
	return (validationStub{passed: true}).InspectContract(ctx, raw)
}
func (p *t222NamedPorts) VerifyContract(ctx context.Context, request domain.VerificationRequestV1) (domain.VerificationReceiptV1, error) {
	if e := p.called(t222Verify); e != nil {
		return domain.VerificationReceiptV1{}, e
	}
	return (validationStub{passed: true}).VerifyContract(ctx, request)
}
func (p *t222NamedPorts) CreateVerificationWorkspace(context.Context, domain.RuntimeProfileRef, domain.WorkspaceFixture, time.Duration) (domain.VerificationWorkspace, error) {
	if e := p.called(t222WorkspaceCreate); e != nil {
		return domain.VerificationWorkspace{}, e
	}
	id := fmt.Sprintf("t222-named-workspace-%d", p.calls[t222WorkspaceCreate].Load())
	return domain.VerificationWorkspace{ID: id, RootPath: "/t222-named-fixture/" + id}, nil
}
func (p *t222NamedPorts) DeleteVerificationWorkspace(context.Context, string) error {
	return p.called(t222WorkspaceDelete)
}
func (p *t222NamedPorts) Stage(_ context.Context, jobID string, artifact domain.AuthoringArtifact) (domain.StagingReceiptV1, error) {
	if e := p.called(t222Stage); e != nil {
		return domain.StagingReceiptV1{}, e
	}
	digest, e := jsonDigest(artifact.Candidate.Blueprint)
	if e != nil {
		return domain.StagingReceiptV1{}, e
	}
	return domain.StagingReceiptV1{Schema: "practice-task-staging-receipt.v1", StagedID: newUUID(), AuthoringJobID: jobID, State: "staged", Created: true, CreatedAt: time.Now().UTC(), FamilyKey: artifact.Candidate.Blueprint.Identity.FamilyKey, VariantKey: artifact.Candidate.Blueprint.Identity.VariantKey, CandidateDigest: artifact.CandidateDigest, BlueprintDigest: digest}, nil
}
func t222Planner(repository domain.JobRepository, ports *t222NamedPorts) Planner {
	planner := newTestPlanner(repository, ports, ports, ports, ports)
	planner.Profiles = ports
	planner.Stager = ports
	planner.Now = func() time.Time { return time.Now().UTC() }
	return planner
}
func t222EvidenceFile(t *testing.T, value string) string {
	t.Helper()
	abs, e := filepath.Abs(value)
	if value == "" || e != nil || !strings.HasPrefix(abs, t222EvidenceRoot+string(filepath.Separator)) {
		t.Fatal("SETUP: seed/result metadata must be inside owned T22 evidence directory")
	}
	if e = os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(abs), 0700); e != nil {
		t.Fatal("SETUP: owned metadata directory")
	}
	return abs
}
func t222LoadSeed(t *testing.T, path string) t222SeedMetadata {
	t.Helper()
	file, e := os.Open(path)
	if e != nil {
		t.Fatal("SETUP: seed metadata unavailable")
	}
	defer func() {
		if e := file.Close(); e != nil {
			t.Error("seed metadata close failed")
		}
	}()
	decoder := json.NewDecoder(io.LimitReader(file, 64<<10))
	decoder.DisallowUnknownFields()
	var result t222SeedMetadata
	if decoder.Decode(&result) != nil || decoder.Decode(&struct{}{}) != io.EOF || result.Schema != "t222-staged-seed.v1" || result.SeedPID <= 0 || len(result.Jobs) != 3 {
		t.Fatal("SETUP: safe seed metadata invalid")
	}
	for _, job := range result.Jobs {
		if !validUUID(job.ID) || !validUUID(job.Key) || job.RequestHash == "" || len(job.RowHash) != 64 {
			t.Fatal("SETUP: safe seeded identity/hash invalid")
		}
	}
	return result
}
func t222RowHash(t *testing.T, ctx context.Context, pool *pgxpool.Pool, id string) string {
	t.Helper()
	var raw string
	if e := pool.QueryRow(ctx, `SELECT jsonb_build_object('row',to_jsonb(j),'xmin',j.xmin::text)::text FROM tz_authoring_job j WHERE id=$1`, id).Scan(&raw); e != nil {
		t.Fatalf("whole retained job fingerprint: %T", e)
	}
	sum := sha256.Sum256([]byte(raw))
	return hex.EncodeToString(sum[:])
}
func t222LedgerHash(t *testing.T, ctx context.Context, pool *pgxpool.Pool) string {
	t.Helper()
	var raw string
	if e := pool.QueryRow(ctx, `SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('row',to_jsonb(m),'xmin',m.xmin::text) ORDER BY filename)::text FROM tz_schema_migration m`).Scan(&raw); e != nil {
		t.Fatalf("migration ledger fingerprint: %T", e)
	}
	sum := sha256.Sum256([]byte(raw))
	return hex.EncodeToString(sum[:])
}
